public_rationale: The surveys make Marcus’s description plausible for generative AI broadly. IBM found substantial exploration in November 2023. But these records do not establish how many companies were trying ChatGPT without using it operationally. Treating broader generative AI findings as direct ChatGPT evidence would change the scope of the claim.
limitations: A broader reading of the software would make the survey evidence more supportive.
Many does not mean most, so existing production deployments do not themselves contradict the claim.
